description: This file defines the Product entity class used to model items in an online shopping system. It includes fields for product attributes such as name, description, price, stock quantity, category, image URL, availability, SKU, and timestamps for creation and update. The class uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping and Lombok annotations to generate boilerplate code.

classes.description: Entity class representing a product in the shopping mall system, with fields for product details, persistence annotations, and automatic timestamp management.
